description: For x402 sellers: one dated report on your own paid resource, by code alone. Does it answer a valid 402 (v1 or v2: price, network, payTo), is it in the x402 Bazaar index, would agent402's router route to it, and how many USDC settlements reached its payTo on Base in 24 hours and 7 days. Nothing is paid to the resource. $0.05. Paid per call in USDC over x402 (Base, or free test USDC on Base Sepolia). An x402-aware MCP client pays automatically: the first call returns the price as an x402 PaymentRequired error, and the retry carries the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one, use the npm client `npx -y crosscheckapi`, which pays from a wallet you set.

method.description: Optional: the method it is paid with; default tries GET, then POST

network.description: Optional: Base, the only network read today

resource.description: The full URL of your x402 resource (public http or https)

name: sellercheck
title: Check an x402 seller's resource
